simpleJp: 過去のトウヴィルでククルに話す
jpGuide1: ククルを仲間にして3連戦
jpGuide2: トウヴィル(過去)　ククルに話しかけイベント→3戦
enGuide: Speak to Kukuru in past Touvil to start the sequence, then clear all three consecutive battles before leaving for Palencia.

simpleJp: パレンシア城跡最深部で火の精霊に会う
jpGuide1: 最深部で火の精霊に会う
jpGuide2: パレンシア城跡→ラマダ
enGuide: The castle-ruins segment is one-way story progression. Keep moving through the forced battles until you reach the deepest room and meet the Fire Spirit.

jpGuide1: 戦闘2回の後、地の精霊に会う
jpGuide2: ラマダ山　イベント進行
enGuide: Travel to Greycine, pass through Ramada Temple, then climb Ramada Mountain. Clear the two required battles and continue to the Earth Spirit event.

simpleJp: ミスロで石像を動かす
jpGuide1: 宝箱から「スーパーブーツ」を入手できる
jpGuide2: ミスロ（過去）の鍵付き宝箱
enGuide: Push the statues into the required arrangement so the locked treasure opens, then take Super Boots. Also check the west side for the partially hidden Dark Mask if completing unique loot.

jpGuide1: 戦闘後、ウォーロックと2人で戦闘。風の精霊に会う
enGuide: Clear the arena sequence as Kukuru's side progresses. The final phase includes a fight involving the Warlock; afterward the Wind Spirit event triggers.

simpleJp: アゼンダ高地奥のゴーレムを調べる
jpGuide1: ゴーレムをどけることはできないので一度引き返す
jpGuide2: アゼンダ高地→一度引き返す
enGuide: Go all the way to the blocked Azenda route and inspect/approach the Golem. You cannot pass yet; backing out is the intended trigger for the Gazalua errand chain.

simpleJp: ガザルアの宿屋へ行く
jpGuide1: ネックレスを1000Gで購入して宿に届ける
jpGuide2: ガザルア　宿屋→酒場→医者→ショップ
enGuide: Follow the local information chain through the inn, tavern, doctor, and shop. Buy the necklace for 1000G and deliver it back to the inn to resolve the blockage.

simpleJp: アゼンダ高地奥で光の精霊に会う
jpGuide1: 奥へ行き、光の精霊に会う
jpGuide2: アゼンダ高地　イベント進行
enGuide: Then fly from Alaratos to Alibarsha.

jpGuide1: 戦闘後、水の精霊に会う
jpGuide2: エルザーク→サリュ族の村跡→水の神殿
enGuide: Travel through Elzark and the ruined Saryu village to Water Temple. Win the required battle there and continue to the Water Spirit event.

simpleJp: パレンシアの帰還確認で「準備がいい」を選ぶ
jpGuide1: 準備がいいと答えればトウヴィルへ
enGuide: When asked if you are ready, choose 「準備がいい」. The story returns you to Touvil; finish the temple battle to close the past-world segment.
